title: Supply of 4.0 sq.mm & 16 sq.mm Copper Armoured Cables for Metro Project
raw_text:
SECTION I: NOTICE INVITING TENDER (NIT)
---------------------------------------
Name of Work: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Low Voltage Cables.

SECTION II: TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
------------------------------------
1. Item No. 1: 
   - Description: 1100V Grade, Single Core, Unsheathed, Multistrand Flexible Copper Conductor Cable.
   - Conductor Size: 4.0 sq.mm.
   - Insulation: Flame Retardant (FR) PVC compound.
   - Standard: Conformity to IS:694.
   - Color: Red, Black, Blue.
   - Quantity: 15,000 Meters.

2. Item No. 2:
   - Description: 4 Core, Round Flexible Industrial Cable.
   - Conductor Size: 16 sq.mm.
   - Insulation: PVC Insulated and PVC Sheathed.
   - Conductor: Plain Annealed Copper.
   - Quantity: 5,000 Meters.

SECTION III: TESTING REQUIREMENTS
---------------------------------
The following tests must be conducted at the manufacturer's works:
1. High Voltage Spark Test (3.5kV).
2. Conductor Resistance Test (Max 4.95 Ohm/km for 4.0 sqmm).
3. Flammability Test as per IS:10810.
